quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso annual securities report: FY2025 (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 46,189 million (-13.0%), operating profit JPY 6,759 million (-44.8%), ordinary profit JPY 8,091 million (-40.0%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 5,464 million (-45.1%); against the company's forecast of JPY 48,000 million net sales and JPY 7,500 million operating profit, sales were 3.8% and operating profit 9.9% below. Management states demand for some applications such as cutting-edge products for generative AI was strong, but adjustment continued across the semiconductor market and Si and SiC semiconductor applications were sluggish. Segments: Japan JPY 24,184 million (-18.1%; semiconductor applications fell sharply on market adjustment), operating profit JPY 4,374 million (-60.6%); US JPY 4,618 million (-7.1%); Europe JPY 4,908 million (-7.0%); Asia JPY 12,477 million (-6.2%). In Q4 the company cut staff to optimise production at its Chinese subsidiaries' carbon brush business (special retirement payments JPY 203 million); it also booked an impairment loss of JPY 452 million on Toyo Tanso (Zhejiang) business assets in Asia on changes in the market environment.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 46,189 million (-13.0%); operating profit JPY 6,759 million (-44.8%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso annual securities report: FY2025 (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Medium-to-long-term targets (annual securities report): under its 2030 Management Vision the company targets net sales of JPY 74.0 billion and operating profit of JPY 18.0 billion in 2030, with company-wide ROE of 10% or more. Management's outlook for 2026: steady demand in electronics and energy on the spread of generative AI, more data centers and vehicle electrification; adjustment continues in SiC semiconductor applications on weak EV demand, while Si semiconductor demand is expected to recover moderately from the second half of the year; firm demand expected for metallurgical applications.
quarterly_data.figure: 2030 targets: net sales JPY 74.0 billion; operating profit JPY 18.0 billion; ROE 10% or more

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso annual securities report: FY2025 (03-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual securities report): FY2025 R&D spending JPY 1,239 million, 66 R&D staff. The company developed graphite for semiconductor manufacturing that is under market evaluation, in particular a material with entirely different properties for semiconductor single-crystal manufacturing parts; for SiC-coated graphite it is improving high-purity treatment of the base graphite, developing higher-quality grades with new processes to meet next-generation quality requirements and studying manufacturing equipment; it is developing graphite materials and products for multi-purpose high-temperature gas-cooled reactors. Porous carbon CNovel won adoptions for fuel cells in Japan and overseas in 2025; Shanghai Toyo Tanso is producing aluminium nitride prototypes as a heat-dissipation filler for electronic components, under user evaluation for uses such as communication-equipment heat dissipation; joint research with NIMS produced a carbon electrode for lithium-air batteries.
